tools.name: list_places
tools.description: Curated places in Kensington, optionally filtered by category, use-case tag or featured picks. Each result links to its https://knowkensington.com/place/{slug} page. rankedUrl is https://knowkensington.com/best/{category} for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop, and https://knowkensington.co

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Full editorial record for one Kensington place by slug, including the guide's description and the public /place URL. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

tools.name: nearby_places
tools.description: Nearest curated Kensington places to a WGS84 coordinate supplied in the request, with distance in metres.

tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Filter curated Kensington places by category, sub-zone, tags, featured picks or text, ranked the same way as the published best-of lists. Every field carries its source; addresses, coordinates, hours, websites and photos are not included, so follow each place url for them. bestOfUrl is included only

tools.name: compare_places
tools.description: Side-by-side sourced records for 2 to 4 Kensington places by slug, with the tags they share. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Published Kensington themed guides (https://knowkensington.com/guides/{slug}), with sourced titles, summaries and place counts.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: One published Kensington guide by slug: its introduction and its ranked places, every field sourced. bestOfUrl is included only for coffee, restaurant, pub, bakery, park, shop.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_place, search_places · Private data: get_place, compare_places · Public sink: compare_places.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_place, search_places · Private data: get_place, compare_places · Public sink: compare_places

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_places" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
